notes.title: Update 03/11/16 - Content Update 0.8.4
notes.content:
The first content update is here, with new cards, stats and a shop!
Unfortunately due to an update to character stats, old saves are incompatible with this update.

Patch notes update version 0.8.4
--------------------------------
Added "ace in the hole" instant card
Added "ace up your sleeve" instant card
Added "clairvoyance" instant card
Tied event outcomes more closely to character stats
Created card shop store front
Added stat purchase
Added deck card purchase
Added hand card purchase
Added credit score rating system
Added scratch cards
Misc. bug fixes
